name: Lift.KummerChart.JumpLattice.valueAt_mem_hodgeFil_of_mem_ainfLattice
summary: φ^{−a}x lies in the letter part at σ^{−a}(i), so it is fixed by letterProj there; its A_inf-span argument reduces to 1 ⊗ t, where the type condition of μ applies.

steps.claim: φ^{−a}x ∈ letterPart(L, σ^{−a}(i)) (phi_pow_smul_mem_letterPart_iff), so letterProj(L, σ^{−a}(i)) fixes it and valueAt(L, a, μ, x) = μ(letterProj(L, σ^{−a}(i))(φ^{−a}x)); φ^{−a}x lies in ainfLattice(L) (smul_mem_ainfLattice), the A_inf-span of the 1 ⊗ t; the preimage of t^{−u}B_dR^+ under μ ∘ letterProj is an A_inf-submodule containing every 1 ⊗ t (the type condition e), so it contains φ^{−a}x.
steps.lean:
congr(μ $(mem_letterPart_iff_letterProj.1
  (phi_pow_smul_mem_letterPart_iff.1 (by simpa)))).subst (mem_span.1 (smul_mem_ainfLattice _ hx)
  (((hodgeFil ..).restrictScalars _).comap (μ ∘ₗ L.letterProj _)) (fun _ ⟨k, h⟩ ↦ h ▸ e.2 k))
